import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextInt()) {
            int n = sc.nextInt();
            int m = sc.nextInt();
            int MOD = sc.nextInt();

            long[][] comb = new long[m + 1][m + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
                comb[i][0] = 1;
                for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                    comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
                    if (comb[i][j] >= MOD) comb[i][j] -= MOD;
                }
            }

            long[] ways = new long[m + 1];
            long[] sum = new long[m + 1];
            long[] sum_n = new long[m + 1];
            for (int sz = 1; sz <= m; sz++) {
                sum_n[sz] = sz + sum_n[sz - 1];
            }
            ways[0] = 1;

            for (int sz = 1; sz <= m; sz++) {
                for (int pos = 0; pos < sz; pos++) {
                    int a = pos;
                    int b = sz - 1 - pos;
                    long to_ways = (ways[a] * ways[b]) % MOD;
                    long add_ways = ((long)(sz + 1) * comb[sz - 1][pos] % MOD) * to_ways % MOD;
                    ways[sz] += add_ways;
                    if (ways[sz] >= MOD) ways[sz] -= MOD;

                    long to_sum = 0;
                    to_sum += (sum[a] * ways[b]) % MOD;
                    if (to_sum >= MOD) to_sum -= MOD;
                    to_sum += (sum[b] * ways[a]) % MOD;
                    if (to_sum >= MOD) to_sum -= MOD;

                    long add_sum1 = ((long)(sz + 1) * comb[sz - 1][pos] % MOD) * to_sum % MOD;
                    sum[sz] += add_sum1;
                    if (sum[sz] >= MOD) sum[sz] -= MOD;

                    long add_sum2 = to_ways * comb[sz - 1][pos] % MOD * (sum_n[a] + sum_n[b]) % MOD;
                    sum[sz] += add_sum2;
                    if (sum[sz] >= MOD) sum[sz] -= MOD;
                }
            }

            long[][] ways2 = new long[n + 1][m + 1];
            long[][] sum2 = new long[n + 1][m + 1];
            ways2[0][0] = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= Math.min(i, m); j++) {
                    ways2[i][j] = ways2[i - 1][j];
                    sum2[i][j] = sum2[i - 1][j];
                    for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                        int ni = Math.max(0, i - k - 1);
                        int nj = j - k;
                        long add_w = ways[k] * ways2[ni][nj] % MOD * comb[j][k] % MOD;
                        ways2[i][j] += add_w;
                        if (ways2[i][j] >= MOD) ways2[i][j] -= MOD;

                        long add_s = ((sum[k] * ways2[ni][nj] + ways[k] * sum2[ni][nj]) % MOD) * comb[j][k] % MOD;
                        sum2[i][j] += add_s;
                        if (sum2[i][j] >= MOD) sum2[i][j] -= MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            System.out.println(sum2[n][m]);
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
